Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

18:6502-1971 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SIZE-STICK FOR FOOTWEAR INDUSTRY 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 1 December 1971, after the draft finalized by the Footwear Sectional 
Committee had been approved by the Chemical Division Council. 

0.2 The size-stick for footwear is a simple type of foot measuring device 
with attachment to measure length. It consists of a straight scale with 
one side blocked and other side with a sliding block on a scale ( almost a 
vernier calliper). The main scale is graduated in English Size Scale and 
Paris Point Scale and the sides in millimetre scale. This stick is used for 
measuring foot sizes, the foot being placed on the stick with the heel 
touching to the fixed upright block. Then the sliding block is moved to 
touch the big toe and the reading is taken from the stick. 

0.3 This standard contains clause 3.1.1 which calls for agreement between 
the purchaser and the supplier. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements of the size-stick used in 
footwear industry for measurement of length of foot, 

2. TERMINOLOGY 

2.1 For the purpose of this standard, definitions given, in IS : 2050-1967* 
shall apply. 

3. REQjUIREMENTS 

3.1 Materials 

3.1.1 Siz^-Stick — shall be made from materials as agreed to between the 
purchaser and the supplier. The following materials are recommended: 

a) Wood — seasoned wood of if-^Z-Z)^/ — Adina cordifolia Roxb, fam. 
Rubiaceae, GAMARI — Gmelina arborea and Rose wood. 

♦Glossary of footwear terms. 



IS: 6302- 1971 



b) Plastics — shape and crack resistant type. 

c) Metal — light metal like aluminium alloy. 
Table size-stick shall be of the shape and design as shown 



3.2 Design 

in Fig. i.

Fig. 1 Size-Stick for Footwear Industry 

3.3 Graduation of Scales — The main scale of size-stick (see Fig. 1 ) 
shall be graduated in full sizes ( 8-4 mm ) of English Size Scale in one end 
with indications of half sizes ( 4*2 mm ) and on other end in full sizes 
( 6*6 mm ) of Paris Point Scale. The side scale of the size-stick shall be 
graduated in mJllim^etre. 

Note 1 — The English Size Scale has three sizes in an inch and commences with size 
zero which is 4 inch long. The scale continues with interval of 1/3 inch up to 
size 13 which is 8 J inch long. The numbering breaks off at this size, recommencing 
with size 1 which is 8J inch long and continuing to include the longest size. Half 
size (1/6 inch ) is also marked. 

Note 2 — Paris Point Scale is based on centimetre. A difference of one size 
corresponds to | of a centimetre in length. Unlike English system, this system has only 
one series of number and runs up to size 50 without any break. 

3.4 Finish — When made of wood it shall be finished with French polish 
or resin emulsion coating so that the graduation is not obliterated.
